terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "aws_region" {
  description = "The AWS region to deploy resources into"
  type        = string
  default     = "us-east-1"
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

# IAM User for Terraform automation
resource "aws_iam_user" "terraform_bot" {
  name = "terraform-bot"
  path = "/"

  tags = {
    Name        = "terraform-bot"
    Environment = "Automation"
  }
}

  name        = "terraform-policy"

  description = "Permissions for Terraform-controlled EKS cluster creation and management"

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid      = "VisualEditor0"
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Resource = "*"
        Action = [
          # Auto Scaling

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

variable "aws_region" {
  type        = string
  description = "AWS region to deploy resources"
  default     = "us-east-1"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Admin Group, Policy, Users, and Keys
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_group" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
  path = "/admin/"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "admin_policy_doc" {
  statement {
    sid       = "FullAdminAccess"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "admin_policy" {
  name   = "admin-policy"
  group  = aws_iam_group.admin.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.admin_policy_doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
  path = "/admin/"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "admin_macbook_pro" {
  name = "admin-macbook-pro"
  path = "/admin/"
}

resource "aws_iam_access_key" "admin_macbook_pro_key" {
  user = aws_iam_user.admin_macbook_pro.name
}

resource "aws_iam_group_membership" "admin_membership" {
  name  = "admin-group-membership"
  group = aws_iam_group.admin.name
  users = [
    aws_iam_user.admin.name,
    aws_iam_user.admin_macbook_pro.name
  ]
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Admin Terraform Cloud Group, Policy, User, and Key
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_group" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  name = "admin-terraform-cloud"
  path = "/admin_terraform_cloud/"
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "admin_terraform_cloud_policy" {
  name   = "admin-terraform-cloud-policy"
  group  = aws_iam_group.admin_terraform_cloud.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.admin_policy_doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  name = "admin-terraform-cloud"
  path = "/admin_terraform_cloud/"
}

resource "aws_iam_access_key" "admin_terraform_cloud_key" {
  user = aws_iam_user.admin_terraform_cloud.name
}

resource "aws_iam_group_membership" "admin_terraform_cloud_membership" {
  name  = "admin-terraform-cloud-group-membership"
  group = aws_iam_group.admin_terraform_cloud.name
  users = [
    aws_iam_user.admin_terraform_cloud.name
  ]
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. GitHub Group, Policy, and User
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_group" "github" {
  name = "github"
  path = "/github/"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "github_policy_doc" {
  statement {
    sid    = "GitHubTargetedAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      # ACM
      "acm:DescribeCertificate",
      "acm:ListCertificates",
      "acm:RequestCertificate",
      # CloudFront
      "cloudfront:CreateInvalidation",
      "cloudfront:GetDistribution",
      "cloudfront:GetDistributionConfig",
      "cloudfront:ListDistributions",
      "cloudfront:UpdateDistribution",
      # IAM
      "iam:GetRole",
      "iam:PassRole",
      "iam:ListRoles",
      # Lambda
      "lambda:CreateFunction",
      "lambda:GetFunction",
      "lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration",
      "lambda:ListFunctions",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionCode",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration",
      # Route53
      "route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets",
      "route53:GetHostedZone",
      "route53:ListHostedZones",
      "route53:ListResourceRecordSets",
      # S3
      "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "s3:DeleteObject",
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:PutObject",
      "s3:PutObjectAcl",
      # SQS
      "sqs:GetQueueAttributes",
      "sqs:GetQueueUrl",
      "sqs:ListQueues",
      "sqs:SendMessage"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "github_policy" {
  name   = "github-policy"
  group  = aws_iam_group.github.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.github_policy_doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "github" {
  name = "github"
  path = "/github/"
}

resource "aws_iam_group_membership" "github_membership" {
  name  = "github-group-membership"
  group = aws_iam_group.github.name
  users = [
    aws_iam_user.github.name
  ]
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Serverless Group, Policy, User, and Managed Policy / Role
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_group" "serverless" {
  name = "serverless"
  path = "/serverless/"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "serverless_policy_doc" {
  statement {
    sid    = "ServerlessWorkloadAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      # ACM
      "acm:DescribeCertificate",
      "acm:ListCertificates",
      "acm:RequestCertificate",
      # CloudFront
      "cloudfront:CreateInvalidation",
      "cloudfront:GetDistribution",
      "cloudfront:GetDistributionConfig",
      "cloudfront:ListDistributions",
      "cloudfront:UpdateDistribution",
      # CloudWatch Logs
      "logs:CreateLogGroup",
      "logs:CreateLogStream",
      "logs:DescribeLogGroups",
      "logs:DescribeLogStreams",
      "logs:FilterLogEvents",
      "logs:GetLogEvents",
      "logs:PutLogEvents",
      # IAM
      "iam:AttachRolePolicy",
      "iam:CreateRole",
      "iam:DeleteRole",
      "iam:DetachRolePolicy",
      "iam:GetRole",
      "iam:GetRolePolicy",
      "iam:PassRole",
      "iam:PutRolePolicy",
      # Lambda
      "lambda:CreateFunction",
      "lambda:DeleteFunction",
      "lambda:GetFunction",
      "lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration",
      "lambda:ListFunctions",
      "lambda:PublishVersion",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionCode",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration",
      # Route53
      "route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets",
      "route53:GetHostedZone",
      "route53:ListHostedZones",
      "route53:ListResourceRecordSets",
      # S3
      "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "s3:CreateBucket",
      "s3:DeleteBucket",
      "s3:DeleteObject",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:PutObject",
      "s3:PutObjectAcl",
      # SQS
      "sqs:CreateQueue",
      "sqs:DeleteQueue",
      "sqs:GetQueueAttributes",
      "sqs:GetQueueUrl",
      "sqs:ListQueues",
      "sqs:SendMessage",
      "sqs:SetQueueAttributes"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "serverless_group_policy" {
  name   = "serverless-group-policy"
  group  = aws_iam_group.serverless.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.serverless_policy_doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "serverless" {
  name = "serverless"
  path = "/serverless/"
}

resource "aws_iam_group_membership" "serverless_membership" {
  name  = "serverless-group-membership"
  group = aws_iam_group.serverless.name
  users = [
    aws_iam_user.serverless.name
  ]
}

# Standalone Managed Policy
resource "aws_iam_policy" "serverless" {
  name        = "serverless"
  path        = "/serverless/"
  description = "Managed policy for serverless deployment permissions"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.serverless_policy_doc.json
}

# Trust Document for Lambda and Edge Lambda
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "serverless_trust" {
  statement {
    sid     = "LambdaEdgeLambdaAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]
    principals {
      type = "Service"
      identifiers = [
        "lambda.amazonaws.com",
        "edgelambda.amazonaws.com"
      ]
    }
  }
}

# IAM Role for Serverless Execution/Tooling
resource "aws_iam_role" "serverless" {
  name               = "serverless"
  path               = "/serverless/"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.serverless_trust.json
}

# Role Policy Attachment
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "serverless_attachment" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.serverless.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.serverless.arn
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
output "admin_macbook_pro_access_key_id" {
  description = "Access key ID for admin-macbook-pro"
  value       = aws_iam_access_key.admin_macbook_pro_key.id
}

output "admin_terraform_cloud_access_key_id" {
  description = "Access key ID for admin-terraform-cloud"
  value       = aws_iam_access_key.admin_terraform_cloud_key.id
}

output "serverless_role_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the serverless IAM role"
  value       = aws_iam_role.serverless.arn
}

output "serverless_policy_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the customer managed serverless policy"
  value       = aws_iam_policy.serverless.arn
}

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 4.0.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

variable "aws_region" {
  type        = string
  description = "AWS region to deploy resources in"
  default     = "us-east-1"
}

variable "cloudhealth_aws_account_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The AWS account ID used by the CloudHealth platform to assume the role"
  default     = "454464851245" # Standard CloudHealth production AWS account ID
}

variable "cloudhealth_external_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The unique External ID provided by CloudHealth for your tenant"
  default     = "sample-external-id-12345"
}

# Assume role policy document requiring CloudHealth principal and external ID condition
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_assume_role" {
  statement {
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.cloudhealth_aws_account_id]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.cloudhealth_external_id]
    }
  }
}

# The cross-account IAM role
resource "aws_iam_role" "cloudhealth_role" {
  name                 = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
  assume_role_policy   = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_assume_role.json
  description          = "Role assumed by CloudHealth for cost optimization, asset management, and analytics"
}

# Policy document granting broad read-only/metadata permissions for CloudHealth analysis
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_policy_doc" {
  statement {
    sid    = "CloudHealthReadOnlyPermissions"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "autoscaling:Describe*",
      "aws-portal:View*",
      "aws-portal:ViewBilling",
      "aws-portal:ViewUsage",
      "ce:Get*",
      "ce:Describe*",
      "cloudformation:DescribeStacks",
      "cloudformation:ListStackResources",
      "cloudfront:Get*",
      "cloudfront:List*",
      "cloudtrail:DescribeTrails",
      "cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus",
      "cloudwatch:Describe*",
      "cloudwatch:Get*",
      "cloudwatch:List*",
      "config:Describe*",
      "config:Get*",
      "cur:DescribeReportDefinitions",
      "dynamodb:DescribeTable",
      "dynamodb:ListTables",
      "dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource",
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ec2:Get*",
      "ecs:Describe*",
      "ecs:List*",
      "elasticache:Describe*",
      "elasticache:List*",
      "elasticfilesystem:Describe*",
      "elasticloadbalancing:Describe*",
      "iam:GenerateCredentialReport",
      "iam:Get*",
      "iam:List*",
      "kinesis:Describe*",
      "kinesis:List*",
      "kms:DescribeKey",
      "kms:ListAliases",
      "kms:ListKeys",
      "lambda:List*",
      "organizations:Describe*",
      "organizations:List*",
      "rds:Describe*",
      "rds:ListTagsForResource",
      "redshift:Describe*",
      "route53:Get*",
      "route53:List*",
      "s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock",
      "s3:GetBucketAcl",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
      "s3:GetBucketLogging",
      "s3:GetBucketNotification",
      "s3:GetBucketPolicy",
      "s3:GetBucketPolicyStatus",
      "s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock",
      "s3:GetBucketTagging",
      "s3:GetBucketVersioning",
      "s3:GetBucketWebsite",
      "s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration",
      "s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration",
      "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
      "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "savingsplans:Describe*",
      "sns:GetTopicAttributes",
      "sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic",
      "sns:ListTopics",
      "sqs:GetQueueAttributes",
      "sqs:ListQueues"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

# The customer-managed IAM policy
resource "aws_iam_policy" "cloudhealth_policy" {
  name        = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
  description = "Permissions policy for CloudHealth cost and usage monitoring"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_policy_doc.json
}

# Attach customer-managed policy to the IAM role
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "cloudhealth_attach" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth_role.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth_policy.arn
}

output "role_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the created CloudHealth IAM role"
  value       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth_role.arn
}

output "policy_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the created CloudHealth IAM policy"
  value       = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth_policy.arn
}
